text:
Type: round swivel tub accent chair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, lounge
Style: contemporary, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: velvet-look fabric upholstery, padded cylindrical body, loose lumbar cushion, dark round swivel base
Colors: bright sunflower yellow, black base
Shape: curved enclosed tub back that wraps into a cylindrical body, armless, deep round seat, small back cushion, low disc swivel base, compact and rounded
Feel: cheerful, bold, playful, cozy
Goes with: grey or white walls, black or brass accents, light wood; contemporary or retro living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: This chair is made from moulded high resilience foam that provides comfort and support  and keeps its shape for years.
